description: NaSrAlF₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.78 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.56 Å. There are two inequivalent Sr sites. In the first Sr site, Sr is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Sr-F bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.74 Å. In the second Sr site, Sr is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Sr-F bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.84 Å. There are two inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.81-1.86 Å. In the second Al site, Al is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.81-1.86 Å. There are twelve inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Sr, and one Al atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Sr, and one Al atom. In the third F site, F is bonded to two Na, one Sr, and one Al atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₂SrAl trigonal pyramids. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sr, and one Al atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sr, and one Al atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sr, and one Al atom. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Sr and one Al atom. In the eighth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Sr, and one Al atom. In the ninth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sr, and one Al atom. In the tenth F site, F is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Sr, and one Al atom. In the eleventh F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Sr, and one Al atom. In the twelfth F site, F is bonded to two Na, one Sr, and one Al atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₂SrAl trigonal pyramids.
